name: linux-wayland-suite
description: Comprehensive Linux Wayland configuration plugin for KDE Plasma, GNOME, and multi-vendor hardware: keyboard shortcuts repair, Tongfang/Avell/Clevo matrix unlocking, smart dynamic keyboard power management, native cedilla on US-intl, Wayland clipboard repair, touchpad gestures, Logitech MX Master 3S via logiops, and battery/energy diagnostics.
